description: This file provides utility functions to retrieve information about available compute devices and select the appropriate device for machine learning tasks, specifically in the context of using PyTorch.

methods.name: Dict get_device_info()
methods.description: Returns a dictionary with details about the available compute devices, including CPU and CUDA (GPU) availability and count.

methods.name: str select_device()
methods.description: Determines and returns the best device identifier ('cuda' or 'cpu') for running PyTorch computations.
